🚀 From WWII Naval Intelligence to the Stars: The Untold Story of William Tompkins

William Tompkins wasn’t your average aerospace engineer. Starting in the 1940s with the U.S. Navy’s intelligence division, he helped shape some of America’s most classified aviation projects. He later contributed his expertise at powerhouse firms like ‘McDonnell Douglas’, ‘Lockheed Martin’, ‘NASA’, and ‘Northrop Grumman’ — working on everything from advanced aircraft to the Apollo program.

But what Tompkins revealed later in life shocked the world. In his explosive interviews with Kerry Cassidy of “Project Camelot”, he dropped bombshell claims: secret space programs, extraterrestrial alliances during WWII, and yes — that when Apollo astronauts first touched down on the Moon, they weren’t alone.

In this riveting clip, Tompkins describes Draco Reptilians already stationed there, with massive vehicles hovering and beings reacting to humanity’s arrival. Was the Moon an ancient ET outpost? A control vehicle? Tompkins’ firsthand accounts (backed by his insider career) continue to fuel the biggest questions in ufology.

👽 What do you think — whistleblower truth or incredible tale? Drop your thoughts ⬇️ 🗳️

video_overlay_text_observed: Header card 'Did Apollo 11 Encounter Reptilian's ?'. The clip credits its own source on screen: 'Source: Project Camelot - Kerry Cassidy 2016', with a lower caption identifying the speaker as 'William Tompkins - Naval Intelligence, Lockheed Martin, NASA (Apollo Program)'. The lower half of the frame cuts between NASA lunar-surface photographs annotated with yellow zoom boxes around small bright specks, captioned 'war.gov UAP Release 1 - Apollo 17 image from the moon' and 'war.gov UAP Release 1 - Apollo 12 image from the moon'. Burned-in auto-captions run throughout.
audio_content_summary: William Tompkins, interviewed by Kerry Cassidy, says that when Apollo landed there were seven large craft at the crater with hundreds of nine-foot reptilian beings standing beneath vehicles floating above the surface; that they resemble lizard or alligator people but can shift to appear human; that George H. W. Bush, Bill Clinton and a further recent president were among them while Donald Trump was not; and that some extraterrestrial groups operate vehicles that look like planets, with the Moon itself described as a command-centre vehicle.
implied_frame: A single-speaker account with no documentation offered in the clip. The verifiable part is biographical: Tompkins was a real aerospace-industry figure who described a career spanning Navy intelligence work and major contractors, and he was really interviewed by Kerry Cassidy for Project Camelot in December 2016. The substantive claims are his own recollection and are unfalsifiable as presented — he names no document, and the people he identifies as non-human are named without evidence. The lunar photographs spliced underneath are doing rhetorical work the audio does not support: they are presented as corroboration, but the narration never refers to them and the specks inside the yellow boxes are not identified by any cited analysis. The 'war.gov UAP Release 1' provenance stamped on those images has not been checked here and is the one part of this clip with a testable paper trail.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~10.9 MB); delivery ~11.5 MB webm.
supporting_research_links: Source interview identified: Project Camelot, Kerry Cassidy interview with William Tompkins, 'Selected by Extraterrestrials', recorded/published 2016-12-15, in two parts (~84 and ~87 minutes).
